marque-propos: 20 px pictogram, 15 px word at 700, colour. Never colour alone; never a coloured fill behind the word.
marque-remplace: Replaced by the Negotiations Guide — COP31
marque-note: The word comes from the status name, never from the screen that places it: one cannot write “Cancelled” in a colour that says something else. All forty-two statuses are in section 6.
chargement-propos: The arc when what is coming is unknown, the skeleton when the shape of the list is already known.
chargement-squelette: Skeleton — the last line is shorter, like a real list
chargement-note: An arc, not a spinning disc: under “reduce motion” everything freezes, and only an open quarter circle stays recognisable at a standstill. Section 7 shows it.
vide-propos: What is not there, and when it comes back. One exit, if there is one.
vide-titre: No session matches your topics today
vide-texte: Adaptation and Gender resume tomorrow at 10:00.
vide-sans-texte: Discussions open when your group arrives.
erreur-propos: What failed, then what remains true — in the room, the sentence that saves you is not the failure but the time of the data still on screen.
erreur-texte: The official UNFCCC programme did not answer. The sessions shown date from 11:35.
erreur-une-texte: This document was not kept offline.
erreur-sans-texte: Reading continues offline. Everything kept stays readable.
ephemere-propos: Six seconds, then it fades: it therefore never carries information on its own. What it announces can also be read on the screen or in the header.
ephemere-avec: Show a message with an action
ephemere-sans: Show a message without an action
ephemere-note: It appears at the bottom of the screen, above everything else: the board cannot show it in place, it has to be summoned. It fades by itself after six seconds, a duration read from the token.
feuille-propos: It rises from the bottom and covers the screen: a board cannot leave it open. Handle, firm rule, 56 px options, “Cancel” at the bottom.
feuille-note: Two ways to fill it: a list of options for the common case, free content for sheets carrying something other than single choices — filter checkboxes, reading settings. The scrim closes it, so does Escape, and focus stays trapped inside while it is open.
feuille-signaler-sous: An IFDD expert checks it before publication.
motif-non-annoncee: An unannounced meeting is taking place
confirmation-propos: It interrupts and waits only for a decision. Back on the left, the action on the right; focus lands on Back, so that an over-eager Enter destroys nothing.
confirmation-note: The scrim does not close it: an interrupting question waits for its answer. The dangerous variant turns the right-hand button red, and serves only what cannot be undone.
confirmation-phrase: An IFDD expert checks it before it is shown to others.
confirmation-phrase-rouge: It will disappear for the whole channel. This cannot be undone.
picto-propos: The fifty-seven symbols and their six sizes.
picto-note: Section 4 already shows them one by one, with their names and sizes. Redrawing them here would leave two boards to keep in tune for a single family of symbols.
